title: Chapter 151: A Certain Death!
html:
After finishing his cigarette, Chen Ge rose. Does anyone even use cassette tapes anymore? Where am I supposed to find a player?

After considerable effort, he had finally established a stable relationship with Zhang Ya, only to acquire another specter demanding his attention. He had never imagined that excessive popularity would become one of his problems.

The Haunted House is large enough for the fellow in the tape, provided he doesn’t cause trouble.One detail in the black phone’s description caught his eye. The Crying Tape had a three-percent draw rate, while the Cursed Love Letter’s had been only 0.3 percent. By that logic, the specter in the tape should be weaker than Zhang Ya—probably somewhere between an ordinary Baleful Specter and a Red Specter.

Weaker isn’t necessarily bad. He’ll be easier to negotiate with.

Any Baleful Specter powerful enough to receive a personal page like Zhang Ya’s made him wary. By the time he pushed his bicycle back to New Century Park, a few visitors had already arrived, and Uncle Xu and Xu Wan were waiting outside the Haunted House.

“Chen Ge, where have you been so early in the morning? And why are there chicken feathers stuck to your clothes?”

Business was still quiet, and Uncle Xu had effectively become a part-time Haunted House employee. Whenever he was free, he helped sell tickets outside.

“A little morning mishap.” Chen Ge calmly brushed away the feather and opened the gates for business. All morning, his thoughts kept wandering back to the black phone’s messages. He felt as though he were walking through fog toward an opening, unable to tell whether it led outside or into a monster’s jaws. At 4:30 p.m., he let Xu Wan leave early, closed the attraction, and entered the staff break room.

Time to prepare.He set his backpack on the table and filled it with the mallet, the red-cloth-wrapped cleaver, several packets of salt, a lighter, and a flashlight. Six packs of salt should be enough.

Next, he brought out a second large bag for the white cat and Xiaoxiao.

Let me see what else I’m missing.

When he opened the drawer, the cassette lay inside. It bore no label, only a smeared bloody handprint, as though someone had once gripped it with a blood-soaked hand.

An obsolete relic like this, appearing from nowhere in the Haunted House’s drawer…

The black phone was naturally responsible. Since he knew almost nothing about the tape and feared its inhabitant might wreck the Haunted House in his absence, he tucked it into his bag as well.

That should be everything.He found Xiaoxiao and the jacket carrying the kittens’ scent and placed both in the second bag. Only after a lengthy negotiation did the white cat reluctantly jump inside.

Stay here. I’ll be right back.In the props room, Doctor Skull-cracker’s hammer rested in a corner. That thing has an intimidating presence. It might prove useful.

To fit the hammer into his backpack, he had to remove the mallet and three packets of salt.

The salt may not even work, so I don’t need this much. But the multipurpose mallet has saved me more than once. I can’t leave it behind.

There was truly no room left, however, so he tied the mallet to the outside of the pack.

Together with the black suitcase of livestreaming equipment, his supplies covered the table. I still feel as if I’m forgetting something.

After a moment’s thought, Chen Ge left the break room and entered the Mu Yang High School scenario. No amount of preparation was excessive for a Three-Star Trial Mission. In the girls’ dormitory, he picked up the broken ballpoint pen. “Pen Spirit, I’d like to use today’s divination. Please answer one question.”

He began the Pen Spirit ritual. “What kind of danger will I encounter at the Third Sick Hall?”

The pen trembled faintly. After a long delay, it wrote two words: “Certain death!”

As though determined to emphasize its warning, the Pen Spirit pressed hard enough to nearly tear the paper.

“Certain death?” Chen Ge’s expression fell. “I asked what kind of danger I’ll face. Why are you telling me the outcome?”

His confidence was already faltering before he had even left. When the Pen Spirit offered no reply, his brow furrowed. “You had better be wrong, or we’re all finished.”

He moved to slip the pen into his pocket. The Pen Spirit was part of the Haunted House; how could it possibly sit this mission out?

The Pen Spirit had plainly not anticipated that response. Before his hand left the paper, it hurriedly crossed out its warning.

There’s still a fighting chance?

Hope surged through Chen Ge, only for the Pen Spirit to write a second line: “Don’t bring me with you!”

“Don’t bring you?” He pocketed the pen and strode cheerfully out of Mu Yang High School.

Everything is ready. Time to go.He took out the black phone. Completing three Nightmare Missions had earned him the chance to unlock a Trial Mission.

“Congratulations, Specter’s Favored! You have unlocked the Trial Mission for the Third Sick Hall.

“The Third Sick Hall (Three-Star Scream Factor): Strange noises haunt this abandoned hospital at night. Discover their source.

“Mission Location: The isolation ward of the Jiujiang Third Psychological Convalescence Center.

“Mission Requirement: Enter the Third Sick Hall before midnight and survive until dawn.

“Mission Hint: The opposite of good is evil, and the opposite of right is wrong. What, then, is the opposite of human?

“Do you wish to accept this mission? Warning: Trial Missions remain available for only twenty-four hours. If you do not accept within that period, the scenario will never be unlocked.”

Chen Ge had prepared for this moment. He tapped Accept, and the interface changed. A clock appeared in the upper-left corner. If he failed to enter the Third Sick Hall before midnight, the Trial Mission would end in failure.

The Third Sick Hall… Once I complete this mission, I should find more clues about my parents.Loaded with bags, he left the park and called Liu Dao, who told him to wait at the entrance for a ride.

The sight of Chen Ge and his luggage visibly startled Liu Dao, but he wisely asked no questions. He started the car and drove toward the Jiujiang Third Psychological Convalescence Center.

“Qin Guang’s livestream begins at ten. His last broadcast performed well, so the platform is giving him its full support again. We surrendered the featured slots of two hosts to secure a decent channel and recommendation for you. Please give it your best tonight.”
